title: retractable hooks and garment rod Wall Mount with 2-1/2-Inch Hanging Space, Solid Brass Allied Brass
body_html:
Add space-saving hanging storage with a retractable hooks and garment rod design that pulls out for 2-1/2" of hanging space and retracts when not in use—ideal for modern bathroom hardware and wall mount organization.

  • Retractable function: Rod pulls out for 2-1/2" of hanging space and pushes back in to stay out of the way.
  • Wall mount installation: Helps keep storage off the floor for a clean, architectural look.
  • Solid brass construction: Crafted from brass for everyday durability.
  • 15 lb capacity: Supports up to 15 pounds for coats, robes, or towels.
  • Customizable tip: Remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with a cabinet knob of your choice to coordinate with existing hardware.

Specs

  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Overall size: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L
  • Projection: 1"
  • Hanging space: 2-1/2" (retractable pull-out)
  • Weight capacity: 15 lb
  • Product weight: 1 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Hardware: All mounting hardware included (6/32 toggles)

Installation notes: Fits standard interior walls. Installation requires drilling a 3/4" diameter hole through drywall and 3 small holes around.

Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available, including statement colors to coordinate with contemporary bath accessories.

_previous.title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
